crossRefs.note: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these…
For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he…
and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent…
He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom…
It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that…
“Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him…
Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent…
That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God…

parallels.note: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him…

translations.web: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
translations.bsb: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
translations.kjv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
translations.asv: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me:
